meta.name: ai-content-pipeline
meta.description: Build multi-step AI content creation pipelines combining image, video, audio, and text. Workflow examples: generate image -> animate -> add voiceover -> merge with music. Tools: FLUX, Veo, Kokoro TTS, OmniHuman, media merger, upscaling. Use for: YouTube videos, social media content, marketing materials, automated content. Triggers: content pipeline, ai workflow, content creation, multi-step ai, content automation, ai video workflow, generate and edit, ai content factory, automated content creation, ai production pipeline, media pipeline, content at scale

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建多步骤AI流水线，自动生成视频、图片和配音内容。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想批量生成结合视频、音频和图片的内容。
copy.tagline_en: Build multi-step AI pipelines to auto-produce videos, images, and voiceovers.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automate media creation for YouTube or social channels.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用命令行工具调用多种 AI 应用,按步骤把图片、视频、声音、文字组合成内容流水线。例如先出图,再做动画,添加配音和音乐,最后输出成片。
howto.when: 当你提到 content pipeline、ai workflow、multi-step ai 等关键词,或要求制作 YouTube 视频、社媒内容、营销材料等自动化内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇博客做成视频,加上配音和背景音乐。
say.note: Claude 会先规划步骤,再依次生成图像、音频并合成。

say.text: 先生成一张赛博朋克城市图,再做成缓慢运镜的视频。
say.note: Claude 调用图像生成和动画两个模型完成。

say.text: 写个 30 秒的 AI 主题脚本,再配上女声旁白。
say.note: Claude 会生成脚本文本,并调用 TTS 模型输出语音。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses CLI tools to call various AI apps and stitch images, video, audio, and text into a step-by-step content pipeline. For example, generate an image, animate it, add voiceover and music, then output a final video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like content pipeline, ai workflow, multi-step ai, or ask for automated content such as YouTube videos, social media posts, or marketing materials.

say_en.text: Turn this blog post into a video with narration and background music.
say_en.note: Claude plans the steps and generates assets in sequence.

say_en.text: Generate a cyberpunk city image, then make a slow camera-pan video from it.
say_en.note: Claude runs image and animation models.

say_en.text: Write a 30-second script about AI, then add a female voiceover.
say_en.note: Claude outputs script and TTS audio.
